verdict.rationale: Superpowers supports long-running autonomous execution inside an agent session. Its subagent-driven-development process works through plan tasks with built-in review, often autonomously for a couple of hours (gh-10, gh-6). It also records rulings on non-catastrophic ambiguities and keeps going (docs-2), and it batches micro-tasks (docs-3). This is plan execution the user starts within a session, not background automation: every path stops for approval before implementation (docs-56) and destructive actions still require a human (docs-2). Missing for 10: scheduled or event-triggered automations, running detached in the background without an active session, an automation setup or configuration surface, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
